newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY SOFTER VS BASKET ON SMALL NBP INTERVENTION.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY SOFTER VS BASKET ON SMALL NBP INTERVENTION.

text.p: 1205 GMT - The Polish zloty closed down at 2.41/2.37 percent from the trading band centre against Monday's 2.46/2.43 percent after the central bank bought some $30 million to cap its small gains at midday.
* It closed at 3.1340/50 to the dollar, down from 3.1300/14 on Monday and at 1.8360/70 to the mark, down from 1.8365/71.
* Dealers said the zloty, stopped by the NBP at around 2.51 percent from the floating parity rate, was fuelled by small-scale foreign entry in Polish T-bills.
